title: Untitled Meeting
agenda: 1. Take note of minutes of the previous board meeting held on 19th August 2025
2. Take note of the circular resolution passed on 6th October 2025 regarding change in directors
3. Consider approval of audited financial statement of the company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2025
decisions: The board approved the cost of the report for the year ended 31st March 2025 at the previous meeting
The board approved the availment of financial facility from Bangkok Baroda and confirmed refinancing completion
Shareholder approvals for changes in articles and vendor equity conversion were obtained on 19th August 2025
Mr Philip Clore resigned and Mr We are a appointed as additional director as per circular resolution on 6th October 2025
next_meeting: Budget for next year to be sent out generally by January or February 2026 for April 2026 onwards
